row.body:
Three customers from the east fields brought the same sweet chemical smell in their hair. They said the crop trial crew had sprayed before sunrise. I washed everyone twice; by noon a county van had blocked the road.

I carried it home because there was nowhere open to return it. The mark did not come off when I tried to wash my hands.

I wanted to keep a clean copy, but the stain is where the first entry was crossed out. I have not tried to improve it.

row.body:
I kept the book open so they could see when the last customer had come in. The woman asked for the names instead of the times.

She did not take the whole book. She tore out two pages and left the small notes about hair color and the money owed. One customer had asked me to call his wife. I still have her number, but I cannot remember which page it was on.

We swept after they left. A curl of paper caught under the chair and I put it here in case the customer comes back to pay.
